The '''L-s9.3 laser cannon''' was a type of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] that was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

==Description==
More destructive than the new but more common [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] [[L-s7.2 laser cannon/Legends|L-s7.2 laser cannon]], it had the power to destroy small asteroids in one shot.

==History==
Developed by Sienar Fleet Systems weapons division to provide added firepower against shielded [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fighters. The L-s9.3 laser cannon was most notably used as the primary armament of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]]. However, this weapon was also heavily used by the [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avenger]] and the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]]. It could also be fitted to the [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] and the [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. The [[Predator-class fighter|TIE Predator]] was armed with four of the cannons.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
